root_idea.summary: The root centers on casting, throwing, or putting something away.
root_idea.development: The physical act of casting extends to removal, distance, rejection, and the idea of projecting or reaching far; related derived usages describe distant places, long-reaching objects, and figurative dismissal.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic Form I verb is presented under its normalized perfect-tense dictionary citation form.

senses.definition: To cast, throw, or fling away.
senses.usage_conditions: The direct object is cast away or put out of one's presence; the usage may imply treating it as unwanted or of little account.

senses.definition: To cast off, reject, or renounce something.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in an extended construction for rejecting or renouncing a covenant; this is a constructional Quran-attested interpretation rather than an additional QAC occurrence in the supplied data.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remove, put at a distance, drive away, or dismiss.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes figurative uses of dismissing discourse, leaving something alone, or driving someone to a remote region.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put or propose a question to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction in which a question is presented as though thrown to the addressee; the usage is reported as possibly post-classical.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become evil in disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enjoy or lead a life of ample ease and comfort.
To make something long or high, especially a building.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The intensified Form II verb may indicate making a building very long or both long and high.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, to take long or wide steps while running.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II usage describing the manner of a horse's running.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The bandying of words; a colloquy or discussion with another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression is also used of exchanging songs or singing; the usage is described as figurative or conventional.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Look!
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare Form IV imperative usage linked in the lexical discussion with far-seeing or cast-related expressions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put on a طَرْحَة garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A post-classical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bandy or propose questions to one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reciprocal Form VI usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing cast or thrown away and not wanted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal designation for something treated as unwanted or neglected.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A leopard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare lexical usage with the plural طُرُوحٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Distance or remoteness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun denoting being far away.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A طيلسان, a type of wrap or outer garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The entry notes that this garment term was not known to the Arabs; later usage applies it to a style of head-veil.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Far-extending, distant, or reaching a great distance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to places, dwellings, journey stages, journeys, and distant objects; of a palm, it denotes long racemes or an upper part far from the base, and of a journey it may also imply hardship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a bow, forcefully propelling an arrow far.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes a bow with strong or long-reaching projection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A male that impregnates through the far-reaching effect of its emission.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a man in intercourse and to a stallion whose semen reaches far into the womb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Casting people into dangerous or perilous situations.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied figuratively to time, calamity, or accidents that cast people into positions of danger.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Long or tall, and leaning to one side; especially a camel's hump.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression سَنَامٌ إِطْرِيحٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A question put or proposed for consideration.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun preserves the figurative idea of throwing a question to someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A proud, self-conceited manner of walking with the arms moving up and down.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression فُلَانٌ يُلْقِي الأَطَارِيحَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place where or into which a thing or person is cast or made to be.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figuratively, it denotes a state or condition in which someone has been placed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A spread or cloth, including a horse-cloth or mattress.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Defined as equivalent or similar to مِفْرَشٌ; later usage includes a cloth laid under or over an animal and a mattress.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Far-reaching or sending something far.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a stallion whose semen travels far, an eye that sees far, and a long spear; applied to camels, it can mean swift.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Rejected and disregarded; said of a saying to which no regard is paid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative passive-participial usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Walking or going in a slack, languid, or repeatedly stumbling manner.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes someone fatigued, weary, weak, or seemingly throwing himself down as he walks.
